records.name: Vera Verdecktes
records.biography_en: She gives nothing away except the impression that everyone else already has. Her HyperNorm neighbours are either readable or hiding something, a rule from which she tactfully exempts herself. The two backed cards are less a hand than a border. A dissonant card suggests that privacy need not be deception. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Sie lässt sich nichts anmerken. Die Anmerkungen verwaltet jemand anders.

variant_notes.note_en: She gives nothing away except the impression that everyone else already has.

records.name: Bodo Bluffbedarf
records.biography_en: He bluffs with the expression of someone requesting permission to lie. He stacks three chips like supporting evidence and sorts every question into believed or personally disastrous. The residents' club rewards confidence, so he practises sweating quietly. He once found a dissonant card and has been pretending not to understand it. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Er blufft überzeugend. Leider nur sich selbst.

variant_notes.note_en: He bluffs with the expression of someone requesting permission to lie.

records.name: Kurt Kalkül
records.biography_en: He can calculate every outcome except the one involving people. His pocket abacus can reduce an entire courtyard to three beads and two acceptable outcomes. Ambiguity is filed as arithmetic failure. A neighbour who offered him tea without a wager has made the calculations rather inconvenient. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Wahrscheinlichkeit ist geklärt. Das Gegenüber bleibt fehlerhaft.

variant_notes.note_en: He can calculate every outcome except the one involving people.

records.name: Mona Mitgehen
records.biography_en: She calls every bet because exclusion feels more expensive. She pushes a single enormous chip forward because the building makes belonging conditional on matching the stake. Residents are either in or out. A dissonant card about unconditional company has made her invite the spectators to stay. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Sie geht mit. Die Richtung gilt als nachrangig.

variant_notes.note_en: She calls every bet because exclusion feels more expensive.

records.name: Fiete Fastpleite
records.biography_en: He guards his last chip as if it were the deposit on a different life. The last chip and empty purse prove that hope can survive a very small budget. HyperNorm files him as solvent or cautionary example. He has begun keeping a chair free for neighbours who have nothing left to contribute. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Einsatz ist gering. Die Bedeutung wurde entsprechend erhöht.

variant_notes.note_en: He guards his last chip as if it were the deposit on a different life.

records.name: Don Durchgeben
records.biography_en: He distributes chance with an air of having personally approved it. He deals the courtyard its approved possibilities and categorises surprises as procedure or error. The three backed cards make fairness look comfortably manageable. An ambiguous card has persuaded him to shuffle once more when a frightened resident asks. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Er gibt jedem eine Chance. Die Reihenfolge bleibt sein Geschäftsgeheimnis.

variant_notes.note_en: He distributes chance with an air of having personally approved it.
